owncloud.long_description: ownCloud is a self-hosted file sync and share server. It provides access to your data through a web interface, sync clients or WebDAV while providing a platform to view, sync and share across devices easily — all under your control. Features include file sync & share, collaborative editing with Collabora/OnlyOffice, calendar & contacts, sharing permissions, and a rich app ecosystem.
owncloud.author: ownCloud GmbH
owncloud.changelog: Current stable release with sync, share and collaboration features.

n8n.tagline: Fair-code workflow automation for technical teams
n8n.long_description: n8n is a free and source-available workflow automation tool. It allows you to connect anything to everything via its open, fair-code model. With n8n, you can build complex automations visually, across 300+ integrations, or write custom JavaScript/Python when you need more power. Features include a visual workflow editor, native AI/LangChain support, self-hosting for data privacy, error handling, scheduled triggers, and a community library of 900+ templates.
n8n.author: n8n GmbH
n8n.changelog: AppVault catalog release — n8n latest stable with visual editor and 300+ integrations.

pihole.tagline: Network-wide ad blocking at the DNS level
pihole.long_description: Pi-hole is a network-wide ad blocker that acts as a DNS sinkhole. By blocking ads at the DNS level before they even reach your devices, Pi-hole reduces bandwidth, speeds up browsing, and protects your privacy across every device on your network. Features include a web dashboard, blocklist management, query logging, DNS-over-HTTPS support, and per-client controls.
pihole.author: Pi-hole LLC
pihole.changelog: Latest Pi-hole core with FTL DNS and AdminLTE dashboard.

openwebui.tagline: Self-hosted AI chat interface for any LLM
openwebui.long_description: Open WebUI is a self-hosted web interface for interacting with large language models. It supports Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and many other backends — all from a single, polished chat UI. Features include multi-model chat, conversation history, document RAG (upload PDFs/docs and chat with them), prompt library, role-based access control, and full mobile responsiveness.
openwebui.author: Open WebUI
openwebui.changelog: Latest Open WebUI with Ollama, OpenAI, RAG, and multi-model support.

crewai-studio.tagline: Visual multi-agent AI — no code required
crewai-studio.long_description: CrewAI Studio provides a Streamlit-based visual interface to build and orchestrate multi-agent crews without writing code. Define agents, tasks, and tools through a point-and-click UI, then run autonomous agent teams that collaborate on complex workflows. Features include a visual crew builder, pre-built agent templates, tool integrations, execution monitoring, and export to code.
crewai-studio.author: AppVault / CrewAI
crewai-studio.changelog: Initial AppVault release of CrewAI Studio visual interface.

hermes-agent.long_description: Hermes Agent is an open-source, persistent, self-improving autonomous AI agent developed by Nous Research. It can browse the web, write and execute code, manage files, and learn from its interactions over time. Features include persistent memory across sessions, tool use (web search, code execution, file management), self-improvement capabilities, and local or remote LLM backend support.
hermes-agent.author: Nous Research
hermes-agent.changelog: Initial AppVault release of Hermes Agent.

adguard.tagline: Network-wide ad & tracker blocking with a sleek UI
adguard.long_description: AdGuard Home is a network-wide software for blocking ads & tracking. After setting it up, it covers ALL your home devices, and you don't need any client-side software for that. It operates as a DNS server that re-routes tracking domains to a black hole. Features include a web dashboard, parental controls, safe search enforcement, query log, custom filtering rules, and DNS-over-HTTPS/TLS support.
adguard.author: AdGuard
adguard.changelog: Latest AdGuard Home stable with DNS-over-HTTPS, parental controls, and query log.

wordpress.tagline: The world's most popular CMS, self-hosted
wordpress.long_description: WordPress is the world's most popular content management system, powering over 40% of the web. Self-hosting WordPress gives you complete control over your site, data, and customization. Features include a block editor (Gutenberg), thousands of themes and plugins, user roles & management, REST API, multilingual support, and a massive community.
wordpress.author: WordPress.org
wordpress.changelog: Latest WordPress with block editor and plugin ecosystem.

nextcloud.long_description: Nextcloud is a self-hosted file sync and share server with powerful collaboration capabilities. Beyond file storage, it includes calendar, contacts, mail, office (Collabora/OnlyOffice), Talk (video calls), Deck (project management), and over 200 community apps. Features include file sync & share, collaborative editing, Talk video conferencing, end-to-end encryption, and a rich app store.
nextcloud.author: Nextcloud GmbH
nextcloud.changelog: Nextcloud Hub 8 with Files, Talk, Groupware, and Office.

onlyoffice.tagline: Self-hosted office suite — docs, sheets & slides
onlyoffice.long_description: OnlyOffice Docs is a self-hosted online office suite that enables you to create and edit documents, spreadsheets, and presentations directly in your browser. It offers the best compatibility with Microsoft Office formats and supports real-time collaborative editing. Features include document/spreadsheet/presentation editors, collaborative editing, version history, PDF support, and integration connectors for Nextcloud/ownCloud.
onlyoffice.author: Ascensio System
onlyoffice.changelog: OnlyOffice Docs latest with editors, collaboration and connectors.

gitlab.long_description: GitLab is a complete DevOps platform, delivered as a single application. It provides Git repository management, CI/CD pipelines, container registry, security scanning, package registry, monitoring, and project management — all in one self-hosted package. Features include Git repos, CI/CD with Auto DevOps, issue tracking, code review, container registry, security scanning, and Kubernetes integration.
gitlab.author: GitLab Inc.
gitlab.changelog: GitLab latest with CI/CD, security scanning, and Kubernetes integration.

bookstack.long_description: BookStack is a free and open-source wiki-style documentation platform that provides a pleasant and simple way to store and organize information. It uses a book/chapter/page hierarchy that mirrors physical books, making it intuitive to organize knowledge. Features include WYSIWYG and Markdown editing, full-text search, image management, role-based access control, and multi-language support.
bookstack.author: Dan Brown / BookStackApp
bookstack.changelog: Latest BookStack with bookshelf/chapter/page hierarchy and WYSIWYG editor.

paperless.long_description: Paperless-ngx is a self-hosted document management system that transforms your physical documents into a searchable online archive. It uses OCR to extract text from scanned documents, automatically tags and classifies files, and provides powerful search. Features include OCR, automatic tagging, document types, correspondents, storage paths, full-text search, and a beautiful web UI.
paperless.author: Paperless-ngx
paperless.changelog: Paperless-ngx latest with OCR, tagging, and full-text search.

jellyfin.tagline: Free media system — stream anything, anywhere
jellyfin.long_description: Jellyfin is a free, open-source media system that lets you stream your movies, TV shows, music, and photos to any device. It's a community-driven alternative to Plex and Emby with no premium features locked behind a paywall — everything is free. Features include movie/TV/music libraries, live TV & DVR, hardware transcoding, multi-user support, plugins, and apps for every platform.
jellyfin.author: Jellyfin
jellyfin.changelog: Jellyfin latest with hardware transcoding, DVR, and full client ecosystem.

navidrome.long_description: Navidrome is a self-hosted music streaming server that makes your music collection available from anywhere via a web UI or any Subsonic-compatible client. It handles large libraries efficiently and supports multiple users with individual playlists and favorites. Features include web player, Subsonic API, transcoding, album art, scrobbling to Last.fm, and a clean mobile-friendly UI.
navidrome.author: Navidrome
navidrome.changelog: Navidrome latest with Subsonic API, transcoding, and multi-user support.

kavita.long_description: Kavita is a self-hosted digital library for e-books, comics, and manga. It provides a fast, modern web reader with support for dozens of formats and automatic reading progress tracking. Features include e-book/comic/manga reader, reading progress sync, OPDS support, full-text search, user management, and a beautiful dark-themed UI.
kavita.author: Kareadita
kavita.changelog: Kavita latest with e-book, comic, and manga reading with OPDS support.

photoprism.tagline: AI-powered photo management for your archive
photoprism.long_description: PhotoPrism is a self-hosted application for browsing, organizing and sharing your photo collection. It uses state-of-the-art technologies to automatically tag and find pictures without getting in your way. Features include AI-powered face recognition, location clustering, automatic tagging, advanced search, albums, and a PWA for mobile access.
photoprism.author: PhotoPrism
photoprism.changelog: PhotoPrism latest with AI face recognition, location clustering, and auto-tagging.

immich.long_description: Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution that replicates the features of Google Photos. It provides automatic backup from mobile devices, album sharing, facial recognition, object/scene detection, map view, and a familiar timeline UI. Features include mobile auto-backup, facial recognition, albums, shared libraries, timeline view, map view, and machine learning-powered search.
immich.author: Immich
immich.changelog: Immich latest with mobile backup, facial recognition, and timeline UI.

wireguard.long_description: WireGuard is a next-generation VPN protocol that aims to be simpler, faster, and more secure than IPsec and OpenVPN. This AppVault package provides a WireGuard VPN server with a web UI for managing peers and configurations. Features include a web-based peer manager, QR code config generation, multiple peers, and minimal resource usage.
wireguard.author: WireGuard / linuxserver.io
wireguard.changelog: WireGuard VPN with web UI for peer management.

vaultwarden.long_description: Vaultwarden is an alternative server implementation of the Bitwarden clients, written in Rust and compatible with the official Bitwarden clients. It lets you self-host your passwords with zero lock-in. Features include full Bitwarden API compatibility, web vault, password generator, attachments, TOTP, emergency access, and a tiny resource footprint.
vaultwarden.author: Daniel García / dani-garcia
vaultwarden.changelog: Vaultwarden latest with full Bitwarden API compatibility.

nginx-proxy-manager.tagline: Reverse proxy with a beautiful UI & free SSL
nginx-proxy-manager.long_description: Nginx Proxy Manager is a simple, powerful tool for managing reverse proxies with a web UI. It makes it easy to expose services on your domain with automatic Let's Encrypt SSL certificates. Features include a web UI for proxy hosts, automatic SSL via Let's Encrypt, access lists, custom NGINX config, streams for TCP/UDP, and a clean dashboard.
nginx-proxy-manager.author: jc21
nginx-proxy-manager.changelog: Nginx Proxy Manager with automatic Let's Encrypt SSL and web UI.

traefik.long_description: Traefik is a modern, cloud-native reverse proxy and load balancer that makes deploying microservices easy. It automatically discovers your services, handles SSL termination, and routes traffic based on rules. Features include automatic service discovery, Let's Encrypt integration, middleware (auth, rate limiting, circuit breakers), load balancing, and a real-time dashboard.
traefik.author: Traefik Labs
traefik.changelog: Traefik latest with auto-discovery, Let's Encrypt, and middleware.

uptime-kuma.long_description: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted monitoring tool like Uptime Robot. It monitors HTTP(S), TCP, HTTP keywords, Ping, DNS records, push, steam game servers, and Docker containers with a beautiful status page and multi-channel alerting. Features include a beautiful status page, multi-channel notifications (Telegram, Discord, email, Slack, etc.), multi-user, certificate info, 2FA, and a powerful monitoring engine.
uptime-kuma.author: Louis Lam / louislam
uptime-kuma.changelog: Uptime Kuma latest with multi-channel alerts and beautiful status pages.

portainer.tagline: Docker management UI for your containers
portainer.long_description: Portainer is a lightweight management UI that lets you easily manage your Docker environments — containers, images, volumes, networks, and stacks. It supports Docker standalone, Docker Swarm, and Kubernetes. Features include container/image/volume/network management, stack deployment, a web terminal, role-based access control, and templates for common apps.
portainer.author: Portainer.io
portainer.changelog: Portainer Business Edition features with Docker/K8s management.

dozzle.long_description: Dozzle is a small, lightweight application that provides you a web-based interface to monitor your Docker container logs in real-time. It's perfect for development and debugging — no need to SSH into your server or use the Docker CLI to view logs. Features include real-time log streaming, a simple web UI, container search, regex filtering, and minimal resource usage.
dozzle.author: Amir Raminfar
dozzle.changelog: Dozzle latest with real-time log streaming and regex filtering.

code-server.tagline: VS Code in the browser, self-hosted
code-server.long_description: Code Server (code-server) lets you run VS Code on any machine and access it in the browser. It provides the full VS Code experience — extensions, terminal, debugging, IntelliSense — from any device with a browser. Features include full VS Code compatibility, extension marketplace access, integrated terminal, Git support, multi-language support, and persistent workspaces.
code-server.author: Coder Technologies
code-server.changelog: code-server latest with full VS Code in the browser.

gitea.long_description: Gitea is a community-managed lightweight code hosting solution written in Go. It's easy to install, low on resources, and provides all the essential Git hosting features. Features include Git repository management, issue tracking & pull requests, web hooks, a web UI, user/organization management, and low resource consumption.
gitea.author: Gitea
gitea.changelog: Gitea latest with Git hosting, issues, and pull requests.

stirling-pdf.long_description: Stirling-PDF is a robust, locally-hosted web application that lets you perform a wide variety of PDF operations. Merge, split, rotate, compress, convert, add/remove pages, extract text, add watermarks, and more — all from your browser without uploading files to third-party services. Features include merge/split/rotate/compress, PDF to/from images, OCR, add watermarks, and a clean UI.
stirling-pdf.author: Frooodle / Stirling-Tools
stirling-pdf.changelog: Stirling-PDF latest with merge, split, OCR, and full PDF toolkit.

excalidraw.long_description: Excalidraw is a virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams. It's simple, fast, and perfect for brainstorming, wireframing, and visual thinking. Features include a hand-drawn style, real-time collaboration, shapes library, export to PNG/SVG, and an end-to-end encrypted sharing option.
excalidraw.author: Excalidraw
excalidraw.changelog: Excalidraw latest with hand-drawn style and real-time collaboration.

drawio.long_description: Draw.io (now diagrams.net) is a free, open-source online diagramming tool. Create flowcharts, org charts, UML diagrams, network diagrams, wireframes, and more with a drag-and-drop interface. Features include a large shape library, drag-and-drop diagramming, export to PNG/SVG/PDF, real-time collaboration, and integration with cloud storage.
drawio.author: draw.io / JGraph
drawio.changelog: draw.io latest with drag-and-drop diagramming and shape library.
